## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build, packaging, or dependency update

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results. Explain anything not run.

## Visual changes

Add before/after screenshots or recordings for user-visible UI changes. Write `Not applicable`
when there is no visual change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows existing project conventions.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and documentation are updated where needed.
- [ ] New assets or dependencies include required attribution and license notices.
- [ ] Generated files and lockfiles match their source inputs.
- [ ] I have reviewed the CineWindows Community License and contribution terms.
